title: A Circuit, Not The Circuit: Non-Unique Causal Localisation of the Mamba-2 State Sink
abstract: arXiv:2606.00930v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability routinely reads a probe and labels its top-activating units as the circuit executing the computation. We test the move in Mamba, on the state sink: the selective state-space analogue of the Transformer attention sink, where the Delta-gate fires disproportionately on boundary tokens such as BOS and newline. At Mamba-1 channel granularity the probe's units carry the causal effect. At Mamba-2 head granularity the label-to-locus link breaks in three ways. The causal set is not unique: a near-disjoint set of top-activation heads, sharing almost none of the specialists, matches or exceeds their ablation effect. Representation does not track function: dual heads, a quarter to over a third of all heads, respond alike to BOS and newline yet do not reproduce the specialists' causal profile. And the effect dissociates by intervention surface: perturbing the input-dependent Delta the probe reads moves the loss

translated_title: 一个电路，而非唯一电路：Mamba-2状态汇聚点的非唯一因果定位
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.00930v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：机械可解释性通常读取一个探针，并将其最高激活单元标记为执行计算的电路。我们在Mamba中测试了这一做法，聚焦于状态汇聚点：即选择性状态空间中Transformer注意力汇聚点的类比，其中Delta门在边界标记（如BOS和换行符）上过度触发。在Mamba-1通道粒度下，探针的单元携带因果效应。在Mamba-2头粒度下，标签到位置的关联在三个方面被打破。因果集并非唯一：一个几乎不相交的最高激活头集合，与专家几乎不共享任何单元，却能匹配或超过其消融效应。表征不追踪功能：双头，即所有头的四分之一到三分之一，对BOS和换行符响应相似，却无法复制专家的因果特征。此外，效应在干预表面上分离：扰动探针读取的输入依赖性Delta会使损失发生变化。
tldr: 本文发现Mamba-2状态汇聚点的因果定位并非唯一，高激活头集合不能唯一决定因果效应，且表征与功能脱节，挑战了传统机械可解释性中探针标记电路的假设。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that causal localization of the Mamba-2 state sink is non-unique, where top-activation heads do not uniquely determine causal effects and representation decouples from function, challenging the probe-based circuit labeling assumption in mechanistic interpretability.
